searchText: Just a curiosity in the issue mentioned in the thread: the minimum gas price at 1Gwei is something post London right? I've sent numerous successful transactions on goerli with 1Wei for gas price The minimum gas price is 7 attoeth + the lowest miner's premium. We *expect* the lowest miner premium to be around 1 nanoeth as that offsets uncle risk plus a little bit of breathing room (I think uncle risk is something like 0.6 or 0.8 nanoeth or something). Uncle risks on testnets (especially PoA) are very different than mainnet, but I kind of suspect people will just set it to 1 for simplicity since it is just a testnet. How much gwei is one nanoeth? 1. ``` 1 wei == 1 aeth (attoeth) 1 gwei (gigawei) == 1 neth (nanoeth) 1 Ewei (exawei) == 1 eth ``` maybe this helps https://etherchain.org/tools/unitConverter 😄 Would be great if you could add a column for both WEI and ETH, with every row in the column's respective base unit. Rather than having one column that switches between WEI and Szabo and Finney and ETH seemingly at random. But I have successful transactions with gas price of 1 Wei in Goerli That's why I asked Have a link to the transaction <@755590043632140352>? Yes, give me a sec to wake up, it's still not 6 here. But these are before any fork this year Oh, prior to London that was possible. 0 was possible before London. After London 7 attoeth is the lowest total amount you can pay per gas. Ah yeah, that was my comment, thanks You explained it then yeah, i wish etherchain was open source maybe … 🧐 because then you could just take etherscan's unit converter https://etherscan.io/unitconverter

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: The minimum gas price is 7 attoeth + the lowest miner's premium.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: We *expect* the lowest miner premium to be around 1 nanoeth as that offsets uncle risk plus a little bit of breathing room (I think uncle risk is something like 0.6 or 0.8 nanoeth or something).

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: Uncle risks on testnets (especially PoA) are very different than mainnet, but I kind of suspect people will just set it to 1 for simplicity since it is just a testnet.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: How much gwei is one nanoeth?

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content:
```
1 wei            == 1 aeth (attoeth)
1 gwei (gigawei) == 1 neth (nanoeth)
1 Ewei (exawei)  == 1 eth
```
